title: When Safety Becomes a Vulnerability: Exploiting LLM Alignment Homogeneity for Transferable Blocking in RAG
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the sensitivity of LLMs to safety alignment categories such as 'Social Bias' (which explicitly includes religion as a protected group) and 'Compliance Risk'. It evaluates how these ethical and social filters can be weaponized to cause over-refusal in RAG systems.
